result:
🎯 **Build complete!** The Hero Ops Console app shell is built and deployed. Here's what I shipped:

## Theme & Styling
- Applied the build spec's palette to `src/styles.css`: indigo-biased neutral set with amber-gold action colors, permanently-dark navigation rail, semantic success/warning/destructive/info colors, all in oklch format
- Set up light and dark themes with `:root` and `:root.dark` blocks per spec
- Added responsive utilities (mobile-only, desktop-only classes) for breakpoint control without Tailwind variants

## App Shell Architecture
- **Navigation Rail**: `hlm-sidebar` with logo, six nav destinations, user footer, mobile off-canvas drawer (display:none when closed, respecting responsive gate)
- **Top Bar**: Menu trigger (mobile), search (desktop only), notifications button, theme toggle, account avatar
- **Main Content**: Router outlet wrapped in flex layout for scrolling content
- **Layout**: Grid structure (sidebar | content) on desktop, stacked on mobile

## Routes (lazy-loaded)
- `/dashboard` → Dashboard
- `/roster` → Heroes/Roster
- `/detail/:id` → Hero Detail
- `/recruit` → Recruit
- `/missions` → Missions
- `/threats` → Threats
- `/settings` → Settings

## Theme Switcher
- Toggles `.dark` class on `<html>` via signal effect
- Persists to localStorage (respects prefers-color-scheme if no stored preference)
- Button shows sun/moon icons based on current mode

## Build Output
✅ 463 KB main bundle + 93 KB styles  
✅ 7 lazy chunks (one per screen)  
✅ No compilation errors  
✅ Responsive at 375/768/1280px (sidebar hides/shows, triggers appear on mobile)

The app is ready to receive feature screens from later stages.
